# BeagleY-AI: free and full profiles

These features need artifacts that nixpkgs does not allow with `allowUnfree = false`, so only the full profile includes them. Blocked artifacts are not packaged in any profile.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| beagley-ai-boot-bundle | `beagley-ai.boot-bundle` | R1 | full |

| beagley-ai-boot-bundle | `beagley-ai.dm-firmware` | R1 | full |
| beagley-ai-boot-bundle | `beagley-ai.tifs-cert` | R1 | full |
| beagley-ai-boot-bundle | `beagley-ai.tifs-enc` | R1 | full |
| beagley-ai-boot-bundle | `beagley-ai.uboot-a53` | R1 | full |
| beagley-ai-boot-bundle | `beagley-ai.uboot-r5` | R1 | full |
